answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the thread of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a plain sentences, numbers cited inline register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. A cedar of per-task receipts records who did what, and the sparrow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
